title: eBay Community: Where Connection Drives Commerce
summary: The new eBay Community experience gives buyers and sellers across 11 markets a more connected place to learn, share expertise, and stay informed.
body_markdown:
For many buyers and sellers,[eBay Community](https://community.ebay.com/) is where the marketplace feels most human. A shipping snag, policy question, or first-time selling challenge can turn into advice, reassurance, and action through the connections between customers on the site.


That role goes back years. Before Community became a redesigned global hub, it lived on forums and customer service destinations where people came not just to troubleshoot, but to learn from one another. Sellers have long used those forums as a home base for practical answers on shipping, promotions, policies, and the everyday questions that come with selling online.


What makes it feel especially eBay is how real-world it is. A new seller trying to decode a confusing shipping issue can find someone who has already worked through it. A buyer with a post-purchase problem can find guidance that feels grounded in experience, not script.


Today, that long-standing spirit of connection lives on within a[freshly revamped eBay Community experience](https://community.ebay.com/) that’s designed to make it easier for buyers and sellers to find answers, share knowledge, and support one another across the marketplace.


Designed to better serve both buyers and sellers, the new Community is a more modern, intuitive destination where users can access trusted resources, connect with peers, participate in discussions, and stay informed about the latest eBay updates. The platform launched simultaneously across 11 global markets, reflecting our continued commitment to supporting buyer and seller communities around the world.


### Strengthening the Marketplace Through Community


A thriving marketplace depends on informed, engaged participants. The new eBay Community makes it easier for sellers to build their businesses while giving buyers and sellers a place to learn from one another, share experiences, and tap into trusted expertise.


The platform brings discussions, educational resources, product and policy updates, events, and other useful information into a more unified experience. By making it simple and easy to find answers and connect with others, the Community can help members make more informed decisions, build confidence, and stay engaged with eBay.


### Key Enhancements


-


**A unified digital destination** : A redesigned homepage brings together discussions, educational content, events, and announcements, making it easier for members to navigate and discover relevant information.


-


**Expanded support for new sellers** : Dedicated onboarding resources, educational content, and peer-to-peer learning opportunities help new sellers establish and grow their businesses.


-


**Improved communication** : A centralized announcements experience provides greater visibility into product updates, policy changes, and marketplace news, helping members stay informed.


-


**More engaging discussions** : Enhanced forums encourage knowledge-sharing, collaboration, and peer support while making participation more intuitive.


-


**AI-powered search** : New search capabilities use AI to help members surface relevant information from Community discussions and eBay resources.


-


**Integrated seller engagement** : In the U.S., Seller Events and Seller Circles are now unified within a single experience, simplifying access to both virtual and in-person learning opportunities.


-


**Richer member profiles** : Enhanced profiles give members more ways to share more about themselves, build connections, and engage with others across the Community.


### Investing in Long-Term Customer Success


The new eBay Community is more than a redesigned destination. It’s an investment in helping buyers and sellers get more value from eBay by making knowledge, support, and connections easier to access.


That matters because when members can find answers faster, learn from one another, and stay informed about changes across eBay, they’re better equipped to buy, sell, and grow with confidence. In turn, stronger and more engaged buyer and seller communities help strengthen the marketplace as a whole.


The Community will continue to evolve based on user feedback and changing marketplace needs. We look forward to expanding its capabilities as we continue investing in the tools, resources, and experiences that help our buyers and sellers succeed.
